meta.title: DataSkate MuleSoft Integration Services — Pricing Model
meta.purpose: Single source of truth for all pricing computations. Agents and scripts read this file. Never hardcode numbers from memory.

engagementModels.name: IaaS (Managed Service)
engagementModels.implementationFeeNote: Included in monthly managed service rate
engagementModels.paymentCadence: Upfront every 6 months (2 payments over 1 year). Billing starts at go-live, not at contract signing.
engagementModels.covered: Build, deployment, 24/7 monitoring, incident response, connector upgrades, minor enhancements, code ownership, AI roadmap

engagementModels.name: Implementation Only
engagementModels.withFullLicenseNote: AE sells full $50K Anypoint license — implementation fee drops to $0
engagementModels.ongoing: None — code ownership transfers at go-live. Future phases scoped separately.

engagementModels.name: T&M — Time & Materials
engagementModels.description: Dedicated offshore resources billed at actual hours worked. Scope can flex mid-project with written approval. Minimum 80 hours.
engagementModels.useWhen: Scope is evolving or client needs flexibility to change requirements mid-engagement. Switch to IaaS at renewal once flows stabilize.

config.name: Config
config.covers: Field mapping updates, filter value changes, credential rotation, performance tuning

modification.name: Modification
modification.covers: New transformation logic, new condition/branch, additional field requiring new transform

extension.name: Extension
extension.covers: New object type added to existing flow, one-directional becomes bidirectional, new secondary system added

replacement.name: Flow Replacement
replacement.covers: New trigger, new target, fundamentally different business process — old flow closes, fresh 12-month contract starts

policies: No multi-year prepay discounts — 6-month upfront is the only payment cadence
Contract renewal after 1-year term: renegotiated at then-current catalog rate, new 1-year term required
All integration code is owned by the client and lives in their GitHub repository
Decommissioning a flow does not cancel its payment obligation — remaining balance accelerates unless replaced
Client has in-house developer and will self-maintain: always propose Implementation Only. Then pivot to Phase 2 agent development.
